# Two packages that parse a shared file holding a route register it on one mux.
# Without a path prefix the second registration panics; with a prefix per
# package each serves its own copy of the route.

muxt generate
! stdout .
! stderr .

# Same pattern, no prefix: http.ServeMux panics.
! exec go test ./plain
stdout 'conflicts with pattern "GET /help"'

# Each package under its own prefix serves its own copy.
exec go test ./prefixed

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/a": {},
		"example.com/m/b": {},
		"example.com/m/c": {"output_routes_func_with_path_prefix_param": true},
		"example.com/m/d": {"output_routes_func_with_path_prefix_param": true}
	}
}
-- fragments/fragments.go --
package fragments

import "embed"

//go:embed help.gohtml
var TemplateSource embed.FS
-- fragments/help.gohtml --
{{define "GET /help Help()"}}<p>{{.Result}}</p>{{end}}
-- a/a.go --
package a

import (
	"html/template"

	"example.com/m/fragments"
)

var templates = template.Must(template.New("").
	ParseFS(fragments.TemplateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Help() string { return "a" }
-- b/b.go --
package b

import (
	"html/template"

	"example.com/m/fragments"
)

var templates = template.Must(template.New("").
	ParseFS(fragments.TemplateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Help() string { return "b" }
-- c/c.go --

	ParseFS(fragments.TemplateSource, "*.gohtml"))

package d

import (
	"html/template"

	"example.com/m/fragments"
)

var templates = template.Must(template.New("").
	ParseFS(fragments.TemplateSource, "*.gohtml"))

-- plain/plain_test.go --
package plain

import (
	"net/http"
	"testing"

	"example.com/m/a"
	"example.com/m/b"
)

func TestTwoPackagesOnOneMux(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	a.TemplateRoutes(mux, a.Server{})
	b.TemplateRoutes(mux, b.Server{})
}
-- prefixed/prefixed_test.go --
package prefixed

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/m/c"
	"example.com/m/d"
)

func TestEachPrefixServesItsOwnCopy(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	c.TemplateRoutes(mux, c.Server{}, "/c")
	d.TemplateRoutes(mux, d.Server{}, "/d")

	for path, want := range map[string]string{"/c/help": "<p>c</p>", "/d/help": "<p>d</p>"} {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil))
		if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", path, got, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want it to contain %q", path, body, want)
		}
	}
}
